verdict.rationale: Lago offers several exit paths. It can be self-hosted with Docker, so the data sits in your own infrastructure. Every endpoint has a documented API with a public OpenAPI 3.1 schema for programmatic extraction, revenue-analytics dashboards export to CSV, and invoices can be downloaded. None of this amounts to a documented one-step full-data export, so leaving relies on stitching together API calls and partial exports. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or complete account-data export, explicit open-format coverage for all entities (customers, subscriptions, events), migration/offboarding documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of exporting and leaving.
